summary: Pulsenmore Ltd., a Nasdaq/TASE-listed Israeli healthcare technology company, filed a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing that its Pulsenmore FC home ultrasound system has completed registration with the UK MHRA. The registration permits marketing across the United Kingdom and Northern Ireland, following prior European MDR registration. The product targets women undergoing IVF and fertility preservation treatments, allowing at-home vaginal ultrasound self-scans with remote clinical guidance. No transactional or special-situation terms, board recommendations, advisors, or financial details were provided. This is a routine regulatory and commercial milestone disclosure rather than a corporate event.
